messages:
Lina M: Quick drop mini kit for goals & feedback micro-prompts. Copy into reviews or 1:1s.

Evan K: Nice, short is perfect. Can we get a single-line goal + risk field?

Lina M: Yep. Example goal card: Goal: Improve embeddings latency 25% (p50) | Owner: Diego R | Timeline: Q3 end | Risk: quantization may reduce accuracy.

Diego R: Add a 2-bullet manager prompt for calibration meetings?

Lina M: Manager calibration prompt: 1) Concrete impact observed (metric + example). 2) Development plan / next milestone.

Evan K: Self-review 3-line paste please.

Lina M: Self-review 3-line (paste): 1) What I delivered & impact. 2) Key lesson. 3) Next quarter focus. Example: Launched cache sharding, cut cold latency 30% // Learned trade-offs with consistency vs throughput // Next: scale autoscaler + onboard new hire.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: performance window opens in two weeks. Templates saved to People Ops kit: internal://people-ops/quick-review-kits

Diego R: Will use in my reviews, thanks.

Lina M: I'll add these to the templates page and ping #general when live.
